capabilities.body: I-OpenAmer ihlela umsebenzi, iwenze ngamathulusi wamambala — itheminali, isiphequluli, amafayela, ikhowudi — bese ibulunga okusebenzile.
capabilities.title: Umsizi ocabanga nawe

capabilities.body: Iingcoco, imemori namamodeli kuhlala kukhomphyutha le. Akunalitho elilayitjhwa ngaphandle kobana ubawe.
capabilities.title: Iinsetjenziswa zakho, idatha yakho

capabilities.body: Amalimi ali-186, ngalinye ngendlela yokutlola oyifundako. Isikrini sokuthoma sehlelo sikubuza bona ukhetha liphi.
capabilities.title: Ilimi lakho, ngendlela efaneleko

capabilities.body: Amakghono abulungwa emsebenzini ngokwawo, ngalokho imisebenzi yangamalanga iba mifitjhani nawuragela phambili nokuyisebenzisa.
capabilities.title: Ikghono elikhulako

help: Hlola bona ikhomphyutha le iyakwazi ukufikelela ku-inthanethi.
Thomisa ukuhlelwa godu — amagadango aqediweko awaphindwa.
Nange kubhalelwa kabili, vula amarekhodi; imida yokugcina itjho igama legadango.
failure.lead: Akunamatjhuguluko abuyiselwe emuva ngaphandle kokukwazisa — i-OpenAmer ijama lapho ijame khona, ngalokho ukuyithomisa kwesibili kuragela phambili lapho.
failure.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer isese yinguqulo yangaphambilini begodu isasebenza. Akunalitho elitjhugululwe ingcenye kwaphela.
failure.title: Ukuhlelwa akukapheli

language.lead: Ukuhlelwa kuragela phambili ngelimi olikhetha lapha. Ungalitjhugulula ngokukhamba kwesikhathi ehlelweni.
language.title: Khetha ilimi lakho

progress.lead: Ukuhlelwa kwakanye: I-OpenAmer ikhuphela ekutlhogako begodu ihlela ikhomphyutha le. Nayithonyiswa ngokuzako, koke lokhu kuyeqiwa.
progress.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer ijamiselela inguqulo yangaphambilini. Iinkhathi zakho zokusebenza, imemori namasethingi akutjhugululwa.
progress.title: Kuhlelwa i-OpenAmer

cards.body: Vula ihlelo bese uhlathulula ofuna kwenziwe. I-OpenAmer isebenza ngemuva bese ikubikela.
cards.title: Thoma ngomutjho

cards.body: Amasethingi → Ukuvezwa → Ilimi. Amalimi ali-186, ongawatjhugulula ngananyana ngisiphi isikhathi.
cards.title: Khetha ilimi lakho

cards.body: Umsebenzi obuyelelwako uba likghono — ngokuzako utlhoga umlayo owodwa.
cards.title: Ivumele ikhumbule

success.lead: Koke sekulungile. I-OpenAmer seyeyakho — kukhomphyutha le, ngelimi lakho.
success.title: I-OpenAmer seyilungele

bullets: Isebenza kukhomphyutha yakho — iingcoco zakho zihlala kiyo
Amalimi ali-186, kufaka hlangana indlela yokutlola oyifundako
Koke kungatjhugululwa ngokukhamba kwesikhathi; akunalitho elingasatjhugululekiko
welcome.lead: Umsizi wakho. Eensetjenzisweni zakho. Ngelimi lakho.
welcome.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer etja seyilungele. Le ij amiselela inguqulo yangaphambilini begodu ibulunga zoke iinkhathi zokusebenza namasethingi.
welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-OpenAmer
